sources.snippet: In recent years, multimodal agent AI (MAA) has emerged as a pivotal area of research, holding promise for transforming human-machine interaction. Agent AI systems, capable of perceiving and responding to inputs from multiple modalities (e.g., language, vision, audio), have demonstrated remarkable progress in understanding complex environments and executing intricate tasks.
